newsitem.title: LEBANON: BLC rise, Solidere steady on lower turnover on BSE.
newsitem.headline: BLC rise, Solidere steady on lower turnover on BSE.

text.p: Shares of Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce rose and Solidere shares were steady on lower turnover on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Thursday.
BLC shares rose to $12.125 from Wednesday's $12 on trade of 10,000 shares against 15,000. Also 5,000 BLC shares changed hands in two block trades of 2,500 shares each at $12 inside the bourse hall.

BLC is the first bank to list on the Beirut exchange since the market reopened a year ago and its shares have risen steadily since they opened at $11.25 on January 2 when they began trading last week.

Solidere A shares were unchanged from Wednesday's $11.125 and B shares also held steady at $11.5. Turnover in Solidere fell to 14,165 shares from 21,020 a day earlier and value was $159,715.625 from $233,982.5.
There was no trade in the four other listed firms: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The LISPI stock index rose 0.13 percent to 81.83 and the BLOM stock index rose 0.01 percent to 945.90.
